title: Coercion or Predictability?
subtitle: Mandarin Adverb–Nominal Degree Constructions
question: Do apparently construction-specific neural effects reflect categorical grammatical processing or continuous expectation-related processes?
text: This project combines EEG/ERP with predictors including language-model surprisal, cloze probability, and semantic association to test categorical and continuous accounts of processing difficulty.

title: Graspability in Disguise
subtitle: The cognitive and neural differences in processing words representing small and big objects
question: Which conceptual dimensions organize the neural representation of words referring to differently sized objects?
text: This collaborative project combines behavioral experiments, EEG, multivariate decoding, and semantic ratings to study neural differences in word meaning.

title: ND250 as a Prediction Error Signal in Orthographic Processing
subtitle: Evidence from comparing ERPs to handwritten and printed words
question: Does the 250-ms ERP difference reflect orthographic-lexicon activation or a prediction-error signal?
text: This project compares handwritten and printed words to investigate the functional interpretation of the ND250 during visual word recognition.
